overview.title: MAT-01 conditional UV protective-window prototype
overview.description: Window-only evidence proposal for a 280–400 nm outdoor sensor. Housing, seal, detector and qualification remain unresolved.

part_definitions.name: Edmund UV fused-silica protective window
part_definitions.description: Edmund supplied Corning 7980 0G, uncoated, 40-20; exact finished optic manufacturer not independently established. Conditional prototype only. Evidence E101–E104.

sourcing_offers.basis: catalog not firm quote; mount/tax/shipping/test excluded

components.rationale: First full-band prototype test article, not optical/mechanical qualification. Evidence E101,E102 and assumptions A01–A03.

configuration.mounting: Unvalidated replaceable perimeter gasket/retainer; no adhesive in aperture; no direct point load

bom.name: Edmund UV fused-silica protective window
bom.rationale: Window only, does not include the housing, seal, retainer or qualification costs.

constraints: Window-only supplier catalog cost; excludes mount, detector, shipping, tax and qualification.
No production release; transmission, haze, impact, seal and lifetime requirements remain unresolved.

critical.description: No candidate is qualified: matched finished-part spectra, acceptance thresholds, impact, seal and outdoor-life validation are missing.
critical.troubleshooting: Resolve requirements and perform the documented component and assembly tests before design approval.
